questions.stem: Shillong, often called the 'Scotland of the East', serves as the capital of which Indian state?

options.option_text: Nagaland, whose official capital is Kohima
Meghalaya, a state carved out of Assam in 1972
Mizoram, the southernmost northeastern state
Manipur, sharing a border with Myanmar in the east

questions.explanation: Shillong is the capital of Meghalaya, created on 21 January 1972 by carving it out of Assam. The 'Scotland of the East' nickname stems from its rolling hills and temperate climate. Nagaland (Kohima), Mizoram (Aizawl), and Manipur (Imphal) are standard distractors since all are NE states; only Meghalaya has Shillong as capital.

questions.stem: Which Union Territory of India, comprising coral atolls in the Arabian Sea, has Kavaratti as its capital?

options.option_text: Andaman and Nicobar Islands, located in the Bay of Bengal
Lakshadweep, India's smallest Union Territory by area
Puducherry, a former French colonial territory in India
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, capital Daman

questions.explanation: Kavaratti is the capital of Lakshadweep, a group of 36 coral atolls in the Arabian Sea and India's smallest UT by area (~32 sq km). Option A is the classic trap: Andaman and Nicobar Islands (capital Port Blair) lies in the Bay of Bengal, not the Arabian Sea — a distinction examiners test regularly.

questions.stem: The planned capital township of Chhattisgarh, originally called Naya Raipur, was officially renamed in 2019. Which leader does it now honour?

options.option_text: Lal Bahadur Shastri, India's second Prime Minister
Atal Bihari Vajpayee, PM when Chhattisgarh was carved out
Rajiv Gandhi, PM who championed computerisation in India
P.V. Narasimha Rao, economic reforms-era Prime Minister

questions.explanation: Naya Raipur was renamed 'Atal Nagar' in February 2019 to honour Atal Bihari Vajpayee, under whose tenure the state of Chhattisgarh was created in November 2000 via the Madhya Pradesh Reorganisation Act. PV Narasimha Rao is the tempting distractor because he was from the neighbouring Telangana region, but had no direct role in Chhattisgarh's formation.

questions.stem: Gandhinagar is the administrative capital of Gujarat, yet it is not the most populous city in the state. Which city holds that distinction?

options.option_text: Surat, renowned for diamond cutting and textile trade
Vadodara, once the seat of the Gaekwad royal dynasty
Ahmedabad, the commercial and cultural hub of Gujarat
Rajkot, associated with Mahatma Gandhi's early years

questions.explanation: Ahmedabad is Gujarat's largest and most populous city; the capital was deliberately located at the planned city of Gandhinagar on the Sabarmati's banks. Surat is the strongest distractor — it is the second-most-populous city and Gujarat's economic powerhouse in diamonds and textiles, leading candidates to conflate economic prominence with capital status.

questions.stem: The AP Reorganisation Act 2014 allowed Telangana and residual Andhra Pradesh to share Hyderabad as a joint capital for a fixed period. How long was this arrangement mandated to last?

options.option_text: Five years, making the joint arrangement last until 2019
Ten years, with Hyderabad as shared capital until 2024
Seven years, with the joint arrangement expiring in 2021
Fifteen years, extending the joint capital status to 2029

questions.explanation: Section 8 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 specifies Hyderabad as the common capital for ten years (2014–2024) or earlier if determined by the President. Five years is the most popular wrong answer, as candidates often confuse this with the 5-year transition windows mentioned in related provisions of the same Act.

questions.stem: Gairsain (Bhararisain) was officially declared Uttarakhand's summer capital in March 2020. In which district of the state is Gairsain located?

options.option_text: Pauri Garhwal, in the lower Garhwal Himalayan region
Tehri Garhwal, known for the Tehri hydroelectric dam
Chamoli, bordering Tibet and the Nanda Devi biosphere
Rudraprayag, where the Mandakini meets the Alaknanda

questions.explanation: Gairsain lies in Chamoli district of Uttarakhand. The notification declaring it 'Garmiyon ki Rajdhani' (summer capital) was issued by CM Trivendra Singh Rawat on 4 March 2020. Pauri Garhwal is the top distractor because it is the Garhwal divisional headquarters and many candidates associate the broader Garhwal region with Gairsain's administrative context.

questions.stem: Daman serves as the capital of a Union Territory formed in January 2020 by merging two earlier UTs. What is the EXACT official name of this merged entity as enacted in the statute?

options.option_text: Daman and Diu and Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Daman, Diu, Dadra and Nagar Haveli Union Territory
Union Territory of Daman-Diu and Dadra-Nagar Haveli

questions.explanation: The merger was effected by the 'Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (Merger of Union Territories) Act, 2019', in force from 26 January 2020. The official name places Dadra and Nagar Haveli first — exactly the reverse of Option A. Since Daman is the capital, candidates instinctively write 'Daman and Diu' first, making Option A the primary trap in this question.
